plans.idea: Keep the original's left-to-right three-column banner but scale everything up to fill the taller canvas: a large logo lockup on the left, a big two-line headline with subhead in the centre, and a bold CTA pill on the right, all centred on one horizontal axis.

Brand lockup anchors the left third at full height while the headline, subhead and CTA stack in one left-aligned column on the right, so the button sits directly under its copy and the hierarchy reads top-down.

Text-first composition: the large headline, subhead and CTA form a left-aligned block on the left that is read first, and the logo lockup signs off on the right as a large brand mark balancing the copy.
